summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built perception systems that detect, track and act on objects: TensorRT-optimized YOLO on NVIDIA Jetson driving visual servoing and a pan-tilt tracking turret, and a CARLA pipeline that trained YOLO11n to mAP50 ~0.85. Writes Python and C++ with PyTorch, trains and deploys machine learning models, and debugs multi-sensor (camera + ToF) hardware to reliable results on real edge computing platforms.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n object detection on 1,133 annotated images, reaching 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.
Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; with optimized homography stitching and concurrency, reached a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm on ADXL345 accelerometer data using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for camera range-gating and contact-triggered grasp at 25 mm via a TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
